news.title: College Park police seize drugs, guns, and cash in 'Operation Zero Tolerance' sweeps
news.summary: Surveillance at a local motel and targeted neighborhood patrols lead to arrests, weapons seizures, and a bust of trafficking-quantity drugs.

news.title: Lithonia man sentenced to life after shooting girlfriend through motel window on 911 call
news.summary: A jury convicted 38-year-old Antonio Robert Watson of malice murder, three counts of felony murder, aggravated assault, first-degree home invasion, and gun charges.

news.title: Woman dies days after being shot, pulled from car in Atlanta: police
news.summary: An attack that started with a woman being shot inside a car and pulled onto a southwest Atlanta street has become a murder investigation after she died at the hospital, Atlanta police said.

news.title: 15-year-old charged after shootout injures 2 women in southwest Atlanta
news.summary: A 15-year-old boy faces multiple charges after a shootout sent bullets tearing into two southwest Atlanta apartments, hitting two women who were inside, according to police.

news.title: Smyrna police roll out new Tasers, body cameras aimed at improving accountability
news.summary: Smyrna police updated their gear with new TASER 10 devices, automatic body cameras, and drones to improve accountability.

news.title: Police investigate reported sexual assault by 3 men inside downtown Athens nightclub
APD disputes ex-officer’s ‘misleading’ social media allegations
news.summary: Atlanta police are disputing claims on social media being made by a former officer.

news.title: Woman accused in Gwinnett mom’s silicone death hid 17 years. Then she renewed her license
news.summary: A woman charged in the silicone injection death of a mother of four ran for 17 years until she tried to renew a fake license, prosecutors say, and a Gwinnett County judge denied bond Tuesday.

news.title: Police searching for man seen on video fatally shooting woman in southwest Atlanta
news.summary: ​According to Atlanta Police, the woman died of her injuries on Nov. 6.

news.title: Woodstock woman convicted of practicing medicine without a license following near-fatal home birth
news.summary: Cynthia "Cindy" Morrow faces sentencing after a jury found her guilty of nine counts involving unauthorized medical procedures and illegal drug possession.

news.title: Gunfire at Dunwoody apartment complex leads to Brookhaven arrest
news.summary: Police swarmed a Dunwoody residential community before dawn Friday after reports of gunfire outside a building sparked fears of a fatal shooting.

news.title: Family plans $75M suit after 18-year-old killed in Newnan police chase
news.summary: The family of Zadarious Dorsey plans to file a $75 million wrongful death lawsuit against the City of Newnan after a city police officer shot and killed the 18-year-old during a foot chase.

news.title: Grieving family says 14, 17-year-old brothers gunned down in vape sale were robbed of life ahead
news.summary: Mother recalls moment she learned her teen sons were shot. Gwinnett County Police arrest 19-year-old in connection with their deaths.

news.title: Woman raped by three men during Halloween event at downtown Athens country bar, police report says
news.summary: The woman told police she encountered a man dressed as the Joker who offered to buy her a drink. After she declined, the man allegedly grabbed her by the arm.

news.title: Suwanee missing person: Gwinnett police search for Robert Grissom, 81
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are asking for the public's help finding Robert Grissom, 81, who was reported missing in Suwanee.

news.title: Cross Keys High School threat: Student investigated after social media post
news.summary: Cross Keys High School administrators and district police responded quickly to a student social media threat in Atlanta.
